# C03-01 — Brand extraction and visual reference

Status: verified

- Requirements: ST-006, ST-015
- Evaluations: EV-009
- Inputs: confirmed project identity sources, existing brand materials, audience-specific voice decisions and relevant channel constraints
- Output: traceable brand reference with extracted colors, logos, typography, legibility and safe-area guidance, motion and language treatments, and any unresolved or unverified fields
- Dependencies: C02-03, C01-01
- Changes planned: add a brand workflow that reads configured project sources, records source references and confidence/confirmation state, and produces a reusable visual reference without treating detected style or voice as approved
- Acceptance: shared identity and relevant audience treatments are represented; missing or conflicting identity is surfaced for confirmation; reference fields remain generic and project-configurable
- Verification: 6 focused brand tests cover complete, absent, conflicting and unsafe observations; contract fixtures validate cross-document sources/assets/audiences; independent high-reasoning review reproduced two traceability/reference defects, then confirmed both fixes and no remaining P1/P2 findings
- Limit: does not invent identity, approve inferred style, or prescribe a particular project's colors, assets, audiences or channels
